chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “Carrying a staff removes poverty, and al-Shaytan does not remain alongside it.”

key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the one conveying this prophetic teaching.

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about carrying a staff during travel?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a saying of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم concerning carrying a staff. It presents carrying a staff as a means associated with the removal of poverty and with protection from al-Shaytan.
